codexStages.observed: Deliberate evolution of the Nightlight Catfish. The lure worked, so the System iterated: brighter bloom, and REKINDLE — the ember safe-window shrinks every cycle (2 turns, then 1, then 0) — plus DAZZLE, which blinds for 2 rounds. The idea gets worse the longer you entertain it. Detonation predator. Like the Speedbump it sits perfectly still — but where the Speedbump snaps, this DETONATES. Burst radius 2, the hardest-hitting burst in either wave. The tell is the brightening: 2 beats from glow to boom. It fears daylight — it only sets its ambush at night.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Eureka (burst radius 2, 22-34 damage — the biggest burst so far, telegraphed by brightening). It never moves once placed. The counterplay is simple: see the glow, don't approach, wait for dawn. It seemed like a good idea at the time. Parts: filament (excellent fire-starter), glass, and the lingering feeling you almost did something stupid. Each detonation teaches it to rekindle faster — the ember shrinks from 2 turns to none. And the bloom dazzles (blinded 2 rounds) if it catches you.

encounter.noticeText: The light swivels toward {who}. It likes being looked at.
encounter.adjText: Too close. The glow flares around {who} — it's been noticed.
encounter.painText: It flickers — and the light fixes on {who}, hardening. Pain gets noticed.

encounter.knownTactics: Step OFF the strafing lane, not along it — it can't turn mid-run. It always lands after a run, hit or miss. Punish the landing.
encounter.comment: Wave-1 flyer: perch (high, untargetable by melee/spear) → strafe (3-lane dive, shadow telegraph) → grounded (vulnerable 1-2 turns). Speaks with the voices of the run's dead.
encounter.knownCue: The shadow moves first. When it detaches, the lane is already chosen — MOVE OFF IT.

attack.telegraph: No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt.

it dives twice — dodge the second one too
after the second dive it's spent — that's the window

edible.note: Owl. Tastes like chicken that judged you first.

codexStages.unknown: Something passed over the fire last night. No wingsound. The flames leaned away from it, politely.
codexStages.observed: Great horned owl. The System classified silence as a hunting strategy and removed the last of the sound. It dives at your shadow — the moon-shadow on the ground is the only warning, because there is no sound. Dodge it once and it comes again IMMEDIATELY, aimed at where you moved. Dodge twice and it's spent, grounded, yours.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Adjournment (silent dive, shadow telegraph — dodge), the Second Hearing (a missed dive is re-aimed at your new position with no extra windup — dodge AGAIN), Spent (grounded 2 turns after the second dive). It never makes a sound. Watch the ground. The talons make fine tools.

unknown: the absence of sound, shaped like wings

encounter.knownTactics: Watch the ground-shadow, not the sky — the dive is silent. A missed dive comes again instantly at your new position: dodge TWICE. Then it's spent.
encounter.comment: Wave-1 flyer: roost (high, silent) → dive (single-tile shadow) → redive (immediate re-aim on miss) → grounded 2 turns. The double-dive is the signature — the punish window only opens after the second.
encounter.knownCue: No sound is the tell. When the shadow grows, MOVE — and move again, because it's already re-aiming.

codexStages.unknown: There's a kite over the treeline. Nobody is holding the string. It has been there three days.
codexStages.observed: Not an animal. The System built its own bird: a kite of dead television, and it watches. It frames a square of ground in scan-light — two beats — then the square SCREAMS. It dips low to transmit. That's when it's yours: melee, or anything, while it dips. It never lands. Don't wait for it to.
codexStages.slain: Moves: The Broadcast (3x3 scan-mark, 2-beat windup — the mark is the mercy, MOVE), the Dip (it descends to transmit, melee-vulnerable, +50% damage — the only window). On its screen: footage of you, from angles that don't exist. It has been watching since before you arrived. Parts: static-glass, and a ticker ribbon with your name on it.

unknown: a kite with no string, holding station over the trees
vibe: it is not hunting you. it is COVERING you

curious: The kite tilts. On its screen, for a frame: you, from above. It is filming.
warn: The screen goes white. It's framing the shot.

encounter.knownTactics: The mark is generous — two full beats to leave the square. When it dips to transmit it's at melee height and takes +50%: that's the only window. Sling/bow can touch it while high.
encounter.comment: Wave-2 flyer (System artifact, not animal): rise (high, drifts at range) → mark (3x3 zone, 2-beat windup) → transmit (zone damage + dips to low, vulnerable) → recover (climbs). The wave-2 step up: zone control, never lands, demands positioning.
encounter.knownCue: When the ground lights up, you're already framed — MOVE. When it dips, it's yours.
